label: Check Point Quantum 3600 firewall
description: Check Point Quantum 3600 - small-office/desktop security gateway (780 Mbps threat prevention, 1.5 Gbps NGFW, 3.3 Gbps firewall): 5x 1GbE RJ45 data ports + 1x 1GbE RJ45 management port; no SFP cages. WAN is any of the 5 copper data ports (typically eth1).
